title: Circular Order For Arrest Of Messrs Wong Chi Tseng And Ngoh Tsao Chueh Cancelled

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 3540.
Date 3 / 5 / 32.

May 2 32.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of
your letter No.4228 of April 16,1932, informing me
that the circular order for the arrest of Messrs.
Wong Chi Tseng and Ngoh Tsao Chueh has been cancelled.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

Assistant Commissioner of Police (Special Branch)
for Commissioner of Police.

President,
Shanghai No.1 Special
District Court.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE & S. B. REGISTRY.
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.
No. D 3540.
Date 21. 4. 32

Translation of Letter from Shanghai No. 1 Special District Court.

l.c.4338 April 16, 1932.

S.M.P. Headquarters,
Shanghai.

Sirs,

With reference to our letter of 18/3/30 concerning the circular order for the arrests of Wong Chi Tsong (王继胄) and Ngoh Tsau Chueh (吴祖樵), both ex-Ministers for China in Mexico, who are wanted for a certain political offence, I have to inform you that the circular order of arrest is cancelled by a letter from the Kiangsu Provincial Government quoting a letter No.261 from the Ministry for Interior Affairs, which in turn quotes an instructional order No.881 of the Executive Yuan in consequence of an application made for its withdrawal by Dr. Wellington V. K. Koo, through Dr. Lo Wen Kan, Minister for Foreign Affairs, on the following grounds :- That the case occurred prior to the issue of the general amnesty of political offenders and that both of them are capable and well-educated, who may render valuable assistance to the League Commission of Inquiry on their arrival in China.

I shall be much obliged if you will kindly have this information circulated among your districts.

Tsen Sien Choh.
President.

警务处处长办公室。
编号 D 3540。
日期 1932年4月21日

上海第一特区地方法院来函译文。

l.c.4338 1932年4月16日。

上海，
上海公共租界工部局总部。

诸位先生：

关于我方1930年3月18日去函提及的通缉前中国驻墨西哥公使黄继胄（Wong Chi Tsong）与吴祖樵（Ngoh Tsau Chueh）一事，该二人因某项政治罪行被通缉。现通知阁下，江苏省政府援引内政部第261号函件，而该函件又援引行政院第881号训令，据此撤销上述通缉令。此项撤销系应顾维钧博士（Dr. Wellington V. K. Koo）通过外交部长罗文干博士（Dr. Lo Wen Kan）提出的撤回申请，理由如下：该案发生于政治犯大赦令颁布之前，且该二人均才干出众、受过良好教育，在其抵达中国后，可为国联调查团提供宝贵协助。

如蒙将此信息在贵局各辖区传达，不胜感激。

曾先作（Tsen Sien Choh）
院长
